title: Value of the refresh_token member in a Canva token response
summary: A synthetic value of the refresh_token member in a Canva token endpoint success response, shown as a pretty-printed JSON body, a compact JSON body behind raw HTTP response headers and the output of a curl request.
rationale: The member is the carrier: Canva describes the refresh_token member of the success response as the token used to refresh the access token, usable once. Canva states no prefix, length or alphabet, so the value is flagged because of the member it sits in, not because of its shape; a refresh token is separate from the resource-API bearer access token. The extent is the member value only.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: a value in the refresh_token member of the token endpoint response is treated as a credential whatever its shape. Canva documents the refresh_token member of the token endpoint success response (carrier existence only); the value admission, extent and a generic attribution are the project's decisions. No subtype is inferred, and no prefix, width or alphabet is claimed.

sources.supports: refresh_token string The token that you can use to refresh the access token.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
